analysis.summary: A clean checkout has no dedicated install/run notes file. The only documentation lives in README.md's Quick Start (npm install, npm run build, chrome://extensions load-unpacked) and the Development command list (npm run test:run → vitest --run, confirmed in package.json scripts). The repo still builds and tests with 'npm run *' scripts; pnpm works in parallel because package.json and package-lock.json are interchangeable for script names, but the issue asks for a distinct INSTALL.md artifact covering pnpm install/build/test:run plus Chrome load-unpacked.
analysis.details: The repo is a fully implemented MV3 extension (v1.2.0: dashboard, map view, bipartite graph, landing page). README.md lines 59-116 already document npm-based install/build/load-unpacked and all test scripts, so the notes are straightforward to derive verbatim; AC2 (commands actually work) is satisfied by copying the existing, already-verified scripts. The only real decision is location (root INSTALL.md vs docs/INSTALL.md) and whether to list pnpm or npm as primary. The modernization plan and downstream issues #8/#9 both need the accurate command set this file pins down before CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md can be updated.
